You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'subway tunnel muralist, 1970s, rendered as graphite concept art'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Lighting reference: a beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'subway tunnel muralist, 1970s, rendered as graphite concept art'.

PANEL. This branch renders the full profile: strict 90-degree side view, silhouette-readable.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — book-matched marble, cast pigmented resin and others — with their wear state, and grade to a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries.
